ORIGINAL_INTENT: issue #542 was a multi-tier detection bug where config-dir heuristics outranked clientInfo; v1's fix was a tiered resolution order, not a single fixed source.
items.question: D4 says 'one fixed source per adapter', but v1's own #542 fix (6-part series) shows detection needed a tiered fallback (config-dir vs clientInfo vs rollout mtime) to work correctly across adapters. If v2 picks a single source per adapter and that source is wrong for one host, this re-opens #542.
items.recommendation: REGRESSION_RISK: real. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: v2 can still have 'one fixed source' per adapter as long as each adapter's single source is chosen from the same evidence that resolved #542 (e.g. Pi/OpenCode use clientInfo, Codex uses something else) — document the per-adapter source table explicitly in the ADR rather than leaving it as a blanket rule, otherwise implementers will pick the wrong source and re-break #542.
